title: Need to commission Vgen artist for emotes and full body
content:

-Vgen link don’t DM
- All rights available (commercial content and merch)
- reasonable cost (no +600% or 100% and 200% that stack)
- Emotes must be Unique/different
- print should fit the style of or be somewhat similar to the pinned PNGTuber

I’m going to sleep so it may be a while before I look, but I will eventually. Refs are welcome. Plz help lol. Price depends on piece, but $30 emote and $150 full body/brb is good, as long as I get full rights (I want to do emote stickers some day for merch potentially)

Also, side note, if you break the third requirement, I will block. Seems rude, but I feel that if you can’t read this, then reading directions will be too hard for you ❤️. If you break the second one, I might reach out to ask about rights.
